newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London edge lower after Dow's surge.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London edge lower after Dow's surge.

text.p: U.S. stocks trading in London were slightly lower on Wednesday following the Dow's impressive run through the key 7,500 mark to a third consecutive record high.
"There's not a lot on the calendar and not a lot of turnover," said one trader. "Prices are looking slightly down."
The Dow finished with a 60.77 point gain at 7,539.27 on Tuesday as investors continued to brush aside fears that the FOMC may decide to raise interest rates at the next meeting on July 2.
